note: The Banger Score: one 0 to 100 number per ad from hook, hold, CTR, CPM and server-side conversions, each as a percentile against ads of the same kind (image, video, document). Weights are renormalised over the metrics an ad has. Small samples are shrunk toward the average, so an ad cannot win on 400 impressions.

definitions.hook: video_views / impressions (LinkedIn counts a view at 2 s with half the player on screen)
definitions.hold: video_q25 / video_views: of the people who stopped, the share still there at 25%
definitions.ctr: clicks / impressions (landing page clicks when the export has them)
definitions.conversion: server-side outcomes from HubSpot by utm_content per 1,000 USD spent, weighted by "outcomes"; never the platform's own conversions

hook_trap.why: A big hook with no hold burns money (Wispr: 39.5% hook rate, 14.3% to 25%)

outcomes_note: Meetings booked count (owner, 2026-10-14). Trial signups are tracked but weigh 0 until the owner sets their worth relative to a meeting.
